verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs describe Sai working across desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals. It continues autonomously after you close the laptop, pings you only when it needs approval, and self-heals saved workflows when the UI changes. That covers cross-app, multi-step tasks without babysitting every step. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-app task reliability, published success-rate figures or failure-handling details beyond vendor claims.

support.subject: As a power user, a multi-step task that crosses several apps completes without me babysitting every step

citations.quote: Sai works across your entire operating system: desktop apps, web browsers, file systems, and terminals, the way a human would.
Sai continues after you close the laptop. Get notified via iMessage and Telegram when it needs you.
you describe the work in plain English and Sai does it on a cloud computer or your own device, asking for approval before sensitive steps.
saved code heals itself. When a step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over from there.
